ns2:section.sectionText: FIN 221 JS is offered for Business Undergraduates intending on a major in Finance. This course will provide additional challenges in the study of Finance. Business students planning to major in Accounting or Business Administration should not enroll in this section. Registration restricted to Freshmen in the College of Business - Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to College of Business. Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
